description: This file defines synchronization utilities for IARM event handling, including templates for managing event handlers per class, registration, and removal functions with thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: Utils::Synchro::IarmHandlers
classes.description: Template struct managing a static map of event handlers per class type.

methods.name: _generic_iarm_handler
methods.description: Template function acting as a generic event handler that calls the registered handler for a specific owner and event ID, with thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedIarmEventHandler
methods.description: Template function to register an event handler with thread safety, associating a handler with an owner and event ID.

methods.name: RemoveLockedEventHandler
methods.description: Template function to remove an event handler with thread safety, erasing the handler from internal map and calling external removal.
